page.title: Bambu Usage Tracking
page.subtitle: Deducts the filament used by Bambu Lab prints from the matching FilaMan spools and keeps a print history with plate previews.
page.footer: FilaManBambuUsage, MIT. Consumption logic ported from OpenSpoolMan (MIT).

status.heading: Printers
status.none: No Bambu Lab printer found. Add one in FilaMan with the Bambu Lab driver.

history.heading: Prints
history.none: No print recorded yet. The next one on a watched printer lands here.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.autoSpend: Deduct automatically when a print finishes
settings.spendOnCancel: Deduct an aborted print at the share it got through
settings.retentionHint: 0 keeps everything. Plate previews are stored with the print, so this is what bounds the size of the database.
